source_discipline: Original geometry and component-placement intent is binding for this revision; source performance wording is not.
Thruster/refillable-reservoir wording is implemented only as generic non-operational interface, allocation, routing and service geometry until a propulsion architecture is selected and qualified.
Doped-crystal labels, xenon/gas effects, graphene-filled coil effects and extraction performance remain quarantined hypotheses.
Derived dimensions make the layout printable, inspectable and serviceable; they do not establish structural or environmental qualification.
Electroplating features are process-enabling references only and require representative coupons and a competent external plater.
No manufacturing, flight or deployment release is created by the digital package.
